summary: Sonoma Pharmaceuticals filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to increase its at-the-market (ATM) offering capacity from $2,070,463 to $3,641,703 of common stock. The issuer, Sonoma, acts through agent Ladenburg Thalmann. As of June 18, 2026, $1,495,830 in shares remain unsold under the prior supplement; the public float is $12,649,011 based on 4,773,212 non-affiliate shares at $2.65. Sales are limited to one-third of the public float annually under General Instruction I.B.6. No premium, fixed price, or board recommendation applies; this is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415. No special-situation mechanics or deal structure are present.
